# computesphere_plan (Resource)

Manages a plan resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source = "computesphere.com/computesphere/computesphere"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

resource "computesphere_plan" "example" {
  name = "example-plan"
  type = "custom"
}

output "plan_id" {
  value = computesphere_plan.example.id
}

output "plan_name" {
  value = computesphere_plan.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the plan.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the plan is active.
- `core` (Number) Number of cores for the plan.
- `country_code` (String) Country code for the plan.
- `currency_code` (String) Currency code for the plan.
- `memory` (Number) Memory for the plan.
- `name` (String) Name of the plan.
- `price` (Number) Price of the plan.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the plan.
- `type` (String) Type of the plan.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = computesphere_plan.example
  identity = { id = "p1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = computesphere_plan.example
  id = "p1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell

```
